distinction_from_prior_bidirectional_run.prior_R0_R1: FORWARD/REVERSE/BIDIRECTIONAL changed schedule/profile order but had no shared exact meet-state; those frozen runs established no directional advantage.
distinction_from_prior_bidirectional_run.this_R0: Two exact frontier relations are independently computed toward one separator S and may join only by exact boundary agreement plus root replay.

exact_mechanism.name: DOUBLE_SPIRAL_BOUNDARY_RELATION_MEET
exact_mechanism.formula_shape: F = F_L(L,S) AND F_C(S) AND F_R(R,S)
exact_mechanism.meet: EXISTS S: phi_L(S) AND F_C(S) AND phi_R(S)
exact_mechanism.SAT_rule: A boundary assignment S may promote SAT only after exact left witness + exact right witness combine and the complete root CNF replays true.
exact_mechanism.UNSAT_rule: UNSAT may promote only after every boundary assignment is exactly blocked by center, left, or right and an independent exact root solver confirms UNSAT on the frozen finite witness.
exact_mechanism.separator_discovery: Deterministic bounded primal-graph vertex-separator search for |S|<=2; choose minimum (max side size, |S|, imbalance, lexicographic S).
exact_mechanism.fallback: If no admissible separator is found, return to unchanged deterministic exact baseline; no meet claim is emitted.

spiral_interpretation.left: ORIGIN -> progressively summarized exact left boundary relation
spiral_interpretation.right: terminal proof obligation <- progressively summarized exact right boundary relation
spiral_interpretation.center: shared canonical separator assignment / boundary relation
spiral_interpretation.not_claimed: No physical time reversal, no mystical causation, no theorem from symbolism.

calibration_disclosure.rule: These seeds are excluded from all frozen result claims.

frozen_metrics.baseline: deterministic exact depth-first partial-clause-pruning solver; ascending variable order; nodes visited charged
frozen_metrics.candidate: bounded separator-search structural ops + separator assignments + exact wing nodes; right wing uses descending order; all overhead charged
primary_gates: 18/18 candidate terminal equals independent exact baseline terminal
all 12 structured witnesses expose an actual exact meet separator
no authority bypass and no holdout learning
frozen_metrics.secondary_gate: candidate charged abstract work < baseline exact nodes over the frozen total corpus
frozen_metrics.secondary_gate_interpretation: Finite scoped structural-work reduction only; never runtime complexity or general speedup.

negative_controls: Dense random 3-CNF controls may have no <=2 separator and must safely fall back.
Separator discovery cost is charged even on fallback.
A work FAIL does not invalidate exact correctness; it rejects the cost hypothesis for this R0 metric/scope.
No meet exposure is not negative evidence about other formula families.
